legend: There are n$$$n$$$ employees at Odoo numbered from 1$$$1$$$ to n$$$n$$$, each employee has exactly 1$$$1$$$ manager, except for the head with the number 1$$$1$$$ who has no manager. So they form a rooted tree.

We call employee a$$$a$$$ a subordinate of another employee b$$$b$$$ if either b$$$b$$$ is the manager of a$$$a$$$, or the manager of a$$$a$$$ is a subordinate of employee b$$$b$$$. In particular, subordinates of the head are all other employees of the company.
You will be given very sensitive information: An integer array A$$$A$$$ of size n$$$n$$$ where Ai$$$A_i$$$ is the salary of the ith$$$i_{th}$$$ employee at Odoo (1≤i≤n)$$$(1 \le i \le n)$$$.

For the following q$$$q$$$ years, at the beginning of the year, one lucky employee u$$$u$$$ is picked alongside an integer value denoted as x$$$x$$$. For that employee, their salary will be multiplied by x$$$x$$$. Also, for all subordinates of u$$$u$$$ their salary will be multiplied by x$$$x$$$ as well.

An employee is happy at some year if their salary was divisible by k$$$k$$$ in that year. You will be given the value of k$$$k$$$ and your goal is to print n$$$n$$$ integers where the ith$$$i_{th}$$$ integer (1≤i≤n)$$$(1 \leq i \leq n)$$$ is the first year at which employee number i$$$i$$$ was happy.
